paite: Uain muhsit hat ahi a, zu khauh kilai hat ahi; kuapeuh huai a paikhial apil kei hi.
english: Wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.

paite: Kumpipa kihtakhuaina humpinelkai humham bang ahi; kuapeuh amah hihheh in ama hinna siatna ding in thil ahihkhial hi.
english: The terror of a king is like the roaring of a lion. He who provokes him to anger forfeits his own life.

paite: Mihing a ding in kinakna a kipan kidang koih zahtakhuaina ahi; himahleh mihai in kinakna abawl ding hi.
english: It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife, but every fool will be quarreling.

paite: Mithadah in phavang in lei alet kei ding; huaiziak in pawltak chiang in azong dia, bangmah anei kei ding hi.
english: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.

paite: Mihing lungtang ah thupha gel tui thuk bang ahi; himahleh theihsiamna neimi in huai asuahkhe ding hi.
english: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water, but a man of understanding will draw it out.

paite: Mi tampi'n amah tung a siam mi atuak ding; himahleh miginom kua'n amu ding?
english: Many men claim to be men of unfailing love, but who can find a faithful man?

paite: Midik ama muanhuaina a-om, amah nung in atate ahampha uhi.
english: A righteous man walks in integrity. Blessed are his children after him.

paite: Kumpipa vaihawmna laltutphah tung a tu in amit in gilou tengteng athehzak hi.
english: A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.

paite: Kua'n, ka lungtang ka hihsiang a, ka khelhna a kipan ka siangthou, achi thei dia?
english: Who can say, “I have made my heart pure. I am clean and without sin”?

paite: Bukna kibang lou leh tehna kibang lou, anih tuaktuak un TOUPA a ding in kihhuai ahi.
english: Differing weights and differing measures, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.

paite: Naupang nangawn in athilhih in amah-le-amah akitheisak a, anasep asiangthou hia, adik hia chih.
english: Even a child makes himself known by his doings, whether his work is pure, and whether it is right.

paite: Za thei bil leh mu thei mit, TOUPA'N anih tuaktuak un abawl hi.
english: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, Yahweh has made even both of them.

paite: Ihmut it ke'n, na genthei kha ding hi; na mit hak in, huchi in tanghou in na tai ding hi.
english: Don’t love sleep, lest you come to poverty. Open your eyes, and you shall be satisfied with bread.

paite: Aleimi in, bangmah ahi kei, bangmah ahi kei, achi; himahleh apai khit nung in, huai chiang in aki-uangsak hi.
english: “It’s no good, it’s no good,” says the buyer; but when he is gone his way, then he boasts.

paite: Dangka-eng a-om, rubi suang tampi; himahleh theihsiamna mukte jewel suangmantam ahi uh.
english: There is gold and abundance of rubies, but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.

paite: Mikhual a dia moh khu dia kichiammi puansilh la in; mikhual numei a dia kichiam ahihleh mohkhuhna ding in len in.
english: Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.

paite: Zuautheihna tanghou mihing a ding in akhum a; himahleh anung in akam suanghum in adim ding hi.
english: Fraudulent food is sweet to a man, but afterwards his mouth is filled with gravel.

paite: Thiltup chiteng thuhoih gel a hihkip ahi; huan pina pil in nang kidouna na bawl.
english: Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!

paite: Kuapeuh tangthu gen a pai vialvial in thugukte akitheisak hi; huaiziak in kuapeuh amukte zapi a hong kithuahpih dah in.
english: He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.

paite: Kuapeuh apa hiam anu hiam hamsiat, zan khomial penpen ah akhawnvak hekmial ahi ding hi.
english: Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.

paite: Atung in kinohtak a gou muh theih ahi, atawpna vualzawl ahi kei ding hi.
english: An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning won’t be blessed in the end.

paite: Gilou ka thuk ding, chi ke'n; TOUPA ngak in, ama'n ahon hondam ding hi.
english: Don’t say, “I will pay back evil.” Wait for Yahweh, and he will save you.

paite: Bukna kibang lou TOUPA a ding in kihhuai ahi; huan khaina kibang lou ahoih kei hi.
english: Yahweh detests differing weights, and dishonest scales are not pleasing.

paite: Mihing painate TOUPA a kipan ahi; huchi ahih chiang in bangchi in mihing in alampi atheisiam dia?
english: A man’s steps are from Yahweh; how then can man understand his way?

paite: Mihing a ding in, "Asiangthou," chih mawkmawk thang ahi, huan anung a thu kan ding a thu chiam.
english: It is a snare to a man to make a rash dedication, then later to consider his vows.

paite: Kumpipa pil in migiloute ahaih a, atung uah chilna kangtalai khe apaisak hi.
english: A wise king winnows out the wicked, and drives the threshing wheel over them.

paite: Mihing lungsim TOUPA khawnvak ahi; gilpi sunglam sungnung penpen avek a zong in.
english: The spirit of man is Yahweh’s lamp, searching all his innermost parts.

paite: Zahngaihna leh thutak in kumpipa ahawi a; huan alaltutphah zahngaihna aletkip hi.
english: Love and faithfulness keep the king safe. His throne is sustained by love.

paite: Tangvalte thupina ahatna uh ahi; putekte kilawmna asamkang uh ahi.
english: The glory of young men is their strength. The splendor of old men is their gray hair.

paite: Keh zou a satna in thil hoih lou asingsiang a; satna in gilpi sunggil lamte azel hi.
english: Wounding blows cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the innermost parts.
